outcome.answer: Updated `starlette_exporter.middleware.PrometheusMiddleware` to support asynchronous label callbacks. `_default_label_values` is now an async method that checks if label callbacks are coroutine functions or return coroutine/awaitable objects and awaits them, allowing async functions (such as reading request bodies via `await request.body()`) to be used for metric labels.
